chapters.label: The perfect pass, live
chapters.text: Euro 2000: Portugal against England, two-all. Rui Costa on the ball. He looks up... and slides it through! Nuno Gomes runs onto it... and smashes it in! Portugal lead three-two!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Rui Costa passes into the space in front of Nuno Gomes, not to his feet. Not too hard, not too soft.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: Behind the goal: one touch, no slowing down, and he lashes it into the roof of the net.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: weight your pass so your striker can run onto it without breaking stride.
